fileId.description: gRPC file ID. Value is obtained by uploading proto file

schemeType.description: API scheme type (Http, Https, or HttpHttps)

host.description: API host name or IP address with port number

servicePath.description: Directory path for the API service

timeBoxInHours.description: Time limit in hours for Automated scan duration

assessmentTypeId.description: Assessment type ID. Values are obtained by calling GET /api/v3/releases/{releaseId}/assessment-types

entitlementId.description: Entitlement ID. Values are obtained by calling GET /api/v3/tenant-entitlements

dynamicScanEnvironmentFacingType.description: Type of environment the server is running in

timeZone.description: Timezone. Values are obtained by calling GET /api/v3/lookup-items?type=TimeZones

requiresNetworkAuthentication.description: True if network connection is required to scan the site, otherwise false

requestFalsePositiveRemoval.description: True if requesting one-time false positive removal, otherwise false

networkAuthenticationType.description: Network authentication type. Values are obtained by calling GET /api/v3/lookup-items?type=NetworkAuthenticationType
